originalTitle: Turning My Story Into a Social Media Growth System
proposedTitle: Turning My Story Into a Social Media Growth System
proposedDescription:
My biggest social media problem is not simply gaining followers — it is creating a clear and consistent content strategy that brings all parts of my brand together.

I have more than 40 years of corporate and technology leadership experience, and I am now building my next chapter as a comedian, keynote speaker, emcee, storyteller, and content creator. My primary audience is women over 40 who are rebuilding, reinventing themselves, and learning that their next chapter can be their boldest one yet.

I need help turning my real life, humor, wisdom, corporate experience, faith, and personal transformation into recognizable content that attracts the right audience and leads to paid opportunities.

I am willing to invest in solving this problem:

How do I build a repeatable social media content system that clearly positions my brand, grows an engaged community, and converts that visibility into comedy bookings, corporate speaking, emcee opportunities, partnerships, media appearances, and long-term business growth — without losing my authentic voice?

I do not want manufactured followers or generic viral content. I want a strategy that identifies my strongest content pillars, signature series, visual identity, platform strategy, posting schedule, calls to action, and a realistic process for filming, editing, publishing, and measuring what works.
rewriteRationale: No direct identifiers to strip. Substantive professional background and audience definition are preserved under rule (b) — stripping them would produce a generic unsolvable problem. Faith and personal transformation remain in the proposed text under rule (c) so Xavier can offer her an optional softer variant if she prefers, without us deciding for her.
